summary: Patterson-UTI Energy Inc. filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a $500M offering of 6.050% Senior Notes due 2036. The notes are unsecured senior obligations, sold at 99.853% of par, with underwriting discount of 0.650%. Proceeds to the company are $496.015M. The notes mature May 15, 2036, with a change-of-control put at 101%. This is a routine debt financing, not a special situation.
